senses.gloss:
ऋषभ ऋषभ, i. e. ऋष् + अन्-भ (vb. भा), m.
 1. A bull, Bhāg. P. 1, 14, 19.
 2. Chief, Bhāg. P. 2, 4, 22; especially as latter part of compound words, ‘best, excellent,’ e. g. पार्थिवर्षभ, i. e. पार्थिव-, m. An excellent king, Chr. 55, 4.
 पुरुष-, m. An excellent man, Rām. 3, 49, 11.
 भरत-, m. A noble descendant of Bharata, Chr. 24, 48.
 सिंह-, m. A fierce lion.
